build_modelopt_fp8_transformer: build an SGLang-loadable ModelOpt FP8 diffusion transformer from a ModelOpt diffusers export
run_fp8_quantization_cli: run the CLI tool to convert ModelOpt FP8 diffusion transformer weights to SGLang format
build_fp8_scale_map: build an FP8 scale map from ModelOpt backbone state dict containing amax tensors
quantize_fp8_weight: quantize a BF16 weight tensor to float8_e4m3fn using per-tensor scale
get_default_keep_bf16_patterns: get default BF16 fallback patterns for a given model type like flux1, flux2, or ltx2
